## Design problem

What are you trying to accomplish that is currently hard or impossible? Describe the workflow, not only the control you have in mind.

## Proposed solution

How you imagine it working. Sketches and reference screenshots from other tools are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

## Scope notes

DreamHouse Studio intentionally excludes cost estimation, bill-of-quantities, first-person walkthroughs, and CAD-format interoperability. Requests in those areas will be declined; see the README roadmap for planned directions.
